ruleDefinitions.name: Important Windows Service Terminated With Error
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects important or interesting Windows services that got terminated for whatever reason Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, param1, Binary

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7023) AND ((param1 = RGX(".*\\ Antivirus.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*\\ Firewall.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*Application\\ Guard.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*BitLocker\\ Drive\\ Encryption\\ Service.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*Encrypting\\ File\\ System.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ Defender.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*Threat\\ Protection.*") OR param1 = RGX(".*Windows\\ Event\\ Log.*")) OR (Binary = RGX(".*770069006e0064006500660065006e006400.*") OR Binary = RGX(".*4500760065006e0074004c006f006700.*") OR Binary = RGX(".*6d0070007300730076006300.*") OR Binary = RGX(".*530065006e0073006500.*") OR Binary = RGX(".*450046005300.*") OR Binary = RGX(".*420044004500530056004300.*"))))
